_proposal: Format-Prototyp. Muss von Dev für alle Komponenten ausgerollt werden.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Button label and content. Alternative to the `text` property.

automatic: Renders a native `button` element — keyboard operability and `role=button` come from the platform.
`disabled` is forwarded as the native `disabled` attribute.
All `aria-*` and `data-*` attributes are passed through to the root `button` element.
consumerRequired: When `noText` is set, provide an accessible label via `aria-label` or visually hidden text — the icon alone is not an accessible name.
testedWith: axe-core (scoped to `.db-button`, default and icon-only variant)

notes: The `type` attribute is computed when not set explicitly: `button` if `onClick` or `commandfor` is present, otherwise `submit`.
